scope: Independent personal comparison review of all five final accepted matched sheets: 90 viewer/Minecraft pairs and 27 additional Minecraft left cells. Fifteen native originals and six viewer originals reopened directly. These overlap prior source and other audit scopes; no aggregate unique-original total is inferred. No production, accepted manifest, immutable proof or original image was edited.

source_research_scope.blocked_attempt: Sandbox ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID before page load; TLS-verifying supported outer Chromium succeeded. No compatibility warning appeared.
source_research_scope.opposite_fly: Distinct appearance while actual first Swim and Hero alignment remain selected.

visual_observations: All nine mod directions use a coherent fresh mint/yellow Swim-first form, distinguish half-mature development and have recognizable mature silhouettes and accents around the original box head.

Run extends the lateral flaps forward/down in face-right side view; Swim extends rear/down; Run+Swim is nearly vertical. Power raises/broadens the paired paddles; Fly raises the colored outer tips and preserves Swim first identity.

Closed rectangular head features and the separate colored Hero halo remain coherent. In this selected static scope, no blocking exposed geometry, stretched face, eye displacement or obvious cap-paint bleed was observed.

Variant halo colors follow the fresh/mature source distinction: yellow fresh, blue balanced, lime/yellow Run, orange/gold Power, yellow Fly, violet Swim, pale gray/mint Run+Swim and dusty pink Power+Swim.

The ABOVE sheet shows clean original head-top skin, separate white/inherited feature roots, variant cap regions and the rigid square Hero halo. Wing lobes, tail and feet remain simple angular parts in the reviewed front/back/side scope.
Native right faces right with forward toes to the right and tail to the left, matching the source side; native left faces left. Source camera pitch and exact obliqueness are not identical.
Fresh Power+Fly eye closure and fresh Power+Swim or mature Run+Fly head/arm gestures are visible existing idle animation differences, not a claim of missing or distorted face textures.
approximations: Two-section block arches and blunt caps approximate smooth tapered source flaps. Fresh roots can read more upright and the long Swim streamers are squared and somewhat compressed relative to the source.

The tiny upturned Run+Fly terminal nib, curved paddle widths, webbed toes, jagged accent borders and tiny source wing details are simplified. Source skull taper/shape changes are intentionally represented with external features around the fixed original box.

The articulated body is slimmer/more upright, feet and tail are squared, and native lighting is darker/flatter than the source. Exact side hides the planar eye layer that remains partly visible in the viewer oblique side.

The common fresh target simplifies source fresh forms that look very similar but are not byte-identical. Linear age and bilinear signed-axis timing differ from source compatible pairs that already look near endpoint around half on both independent tracks.
Static stage views and pose differences cannot establish all transition frames or moving attachment clearances.
explicit_limits: Static selected comparison review; no continuous movie playback or listening certification.
All 8,358 frozen/live/JAR production entries were independently matched. This proves declared development-classpath byte identity, not that runClient loaded the packaged JAR.
Matched sheets use the natural coat. Color/shiny inventory, other accessories and animation/authority tests have separate evidence; this review does not visually certify every combination.
No physical touch, remote two-client multiplayer, full dedicated-world restart or arbitrary historical-world claim.
